translations.web: “Does our law judge a man, unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”
translations.bsb: “Does our law convict a man without first hearing from him to determine what he has done?”
translations.kjv: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?
translations.asv: Doth our law judge a man, except it first hear from himself and know what he doeth?
